summary.text: Farah N. Louis represents the 45th District on the New York City Council, which includes Flatbush, East Flatbush, Midwood, Flatlands, Kensington, Marine Park and Canarsie in Brooklyn.
Her Council biography says she is the first woman to chair the Subcommittee on Zoning and Franchises.

paragraphs.text: Louis is a first-generation Brooklynite raised in an immigrant, pro-union household, and her biography describes her as the first Haitian and Bahamian American Council Member in the city's history.
She formerly chaired the Committee on Women and Gender Equity, where the biography says she worked on maternal mortality, domestic violence support and entrepreneurship for women and girls.

The biography says she has secured over $170 million in capital investments for the district, including a women's health center on Flatbush Avenue, the Shirley Chisholm Recreation Center and the East 25th Street Historic District.
